model: Meta Muse Glimmer 30B NVFP4 (W4A4, vision intact) + DFlash drafter

build.summary: start.sh clones xianbaoqian/vllm branch tiezhen/new-model-support (vLLM PR #51655; README says pinned commit 99a10304d) and installs it editable with VLLM_USE_PRECOMPILED=1 into ./.venv, plus ninja

speculative: DFlash with meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B-assistant drafter head (5 layers, block 16), num_speculative_tokens 16
extra_setup: Bare-metal (no container): needs python3.12, git, CUDA 13 at /usr/local/cuda; start.sh builds ./.venv with the vLLM fork, snapshot_downloads target + drafter into the default HF cache (MODEL_PATH/DRAFT_PATH are the returned snapshot dirs), runs `vllm serve` under nohup writing vllm.log/vllm.pid. 256K context (>131072) additionally REQUIRES two local, uncommitted patches to the fork (muse_glimmer.py and qwen3_dflash.py: size RoPE cos/sin cache to max_model_len) that are described in the README but NOT shipped in this repo; without them positions >131071 crash. Use --max-model-len 131072 otherwise.

measured.concurrency_notes: fp8 KV 2,414,048 token slots = 9.21x 256K at util 0.42; ~13 tok/s without DFlash; single-burst wall clock ~66 tok/s (250-token, DFlash)

notes: Script default GPU_MEM_UTIL=0.42 (reference box). Script header comment names Preyazz/Muse-Glimmer-30B-NVFP4 but MODEL_REPO is RedHatAI/Muse-Glimmer-30B-NVFP4; A16 alternative cloudnathan5/Muse-Glimmer-30B-NVFP4 via MODEL_REPO. Context beyond 131072 is RoPE extrapolation. Final log line says '15 speculative tokens' but config uses 16. Fork branch is unpinned in the script (tracks branch head).
